note: The machine-readable ABI of include/vbm_sse.h. scripts/check_abi.py checks the two agree (Tier 1); scripts/gen-bindings.sh generates the bindings from this file. Types are abstract: u8 u64 int size, ptr (void *), ptr:u8 ptr:ptr (pointer to u8, pointer to a pointer), ptr:NAME (pointer to struct NAME), opaque:NAME (pointer to an opaque struct). Each 'c' is the C text, compared to the header with whitespace removed.

report.doc: header words, then id_len bytes (the last event ID string), then count events, each three length words then type, data, last event ID at dispatch (that many bytes each). retry is 0 when retry_set is 0.
